reason: I already have a manager and four WhatsApp groups for leads, so the scam check is nice but not something I'd pay for. And letting a tiny beta app send DMs and payment reminders from my account is exactly the kind of thing that got me burned before.
objection: Auto-DM and messages sent from my account could get my Instagram flagged, and a small unknown team holding my brand deals and payment details feels risky. At ₹199 a year it honestly looks too cheap to be a real business that will still be around.
would_change_my_mind: Proof it uses Instagram's official API with no ban risk, plus a few established Bengaluru creators I know vouching that it actually got them paid on time.
